validity.recommendation: Have Update re-examine whether StartYear2=1975 belongs on this OIL pipeline's row.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records StartYear1=1973, StartYear2=1975, StartYear3=2008 on this crude-OIL pipeline. The egyptoil-gas.com report's field-history paragraph on Abu Gharadig reads: 'The Abu Gharadig field was discovered in 1969... The first crude oil production was in 1973, while natural gas production started in 1975. In 2008, North East Abu El Gharadig (Neag) block started production...'. StartYear1=1973 lines up cleanly with first CRUDE OIL production (and is independently corroborated by GulfPub's start_year=1973 on its matching pipeline record -- see the existence note above). StartYear3=2008 plausibly corresponds to the Neag block coming online, which is consistent with GulfPub's separate 'Abu Gharadig North East - Center' 22.5 km feeder record (ref 4579) that the matcher scored as a partial/near-miss addition against this same GEM row. But StartYear2=1975, per this same source, is when the field's NATURAL GAS production began -- not crude oil. Putting a gas-onset year on an oil pipeline's Start field is at minimum unsupported by any source found this pass, and may be a genuine field-vs-fuel mismatch carried over from field-level data. Not fabricating a fix; flagging for Update to check whether 1975 reflects a real oil-side expansion (e.g. the second, 16in leg of the 12/16in dual-diameter line) or is a mis-keyed gas date.
